input: Draft an emergency financial plan for job loss scenarios

gold.taskTitle: Draft Emergency Financial Plan for Job Loss
gold.taskDescription: Create a personalized emergency financial plan that prepares the user for the possibility of sudden job loss.

questions.title: How many months of expenses can you currently cover?
questions.description: Understand the user's existing emergency fund or savings runway.

questions.title: What is your approximate total monthly living expense?
questions.description: Establish a baseline monthly burn rate to determine how long funds will last.

questions.title: Do you have dependents relying on your income?
questions.description: Determine whether the plan must account for family members or dependents.

questions.title: Are you currently employed, recently laid off, or anticipating layoff?
questions.description: Clarify the urgency and immediacy of the job loss scenario being planned for.

questions.title: Which fixed expenses are you unwilling or unable to cut?
questions.description: Identify non-negotiable costs such as rent, mortgage, or medical expenses.

questions.title: Do you have access to unemployment benefits or severance pay?
questions.description: Factor in any income replacement sources that would extend the financial runway.

questions.title: What is your target timeline for finding new employment?
questions.description: Set a planning horizon so the financial plan covers a realistic job search period.
